# dither-kit (vendored)

The framework-free painter of dither-kit, the ordered-dither chart kit by Boring Software Inc.:
`dither-paint.ts` and `palette.ts` from its `core` registry item.

- Source: https://tripwire.sh/r/core.json, the registry of
  https://github.com/Boring-Software-Inc/dither-kit (commit `1e7faee`, 2026-07-14)
- Licence: MIT, as the project's `package.json` declares; the notice is below.

Changes are marked in the files with "changed for reseek". The files keep upstream's formatting,
so the formatter and linter skip this directory.
